title: Recipe Finder App
description: Build a recipe finder that stores recipes, searches by ingredients, filters by time and difficulty, and sorts by ingredient match count.

steps.title: Define the recipe data structure
steps.description: Create a `recipes` array with objects containing `name`, `ingredients` (array), `time` (minutes), and `difficulty` (string). Populate with at least 5 recipes and log them.
hints: Recipe: { name: 'Spaghetti Bolognese', ingredients: ['pasta', 'tomato sauce', 'beef'], time: 45, difficulty: 'medium' }
Log the full array with JSON.stringify

codeTemplate.python:
import json

recipes = [
  {"name": "Spaghetti Bolognese", "ingredients": ["pasta", "tomato sauce", "beef", "garlic"], "time": 45, "difficulty": "medium"},
  {"name": "Caesar Salad", "ingredients": ["lettuce", "croutons", "parmesan", "chicken"], "time": 15, "difficulty": "easy"},
  {"name": "Beef Stroganoff", "ingredients": ["beef", "sour cream", "mushrooms", "pasta"], "time": 60, "difficulty": "hard"},
  {"name": "Veggie Stir Fry", "ingredients": ["broccoli", "carrots", "soy sauce", "rice"], "time": 20, "difficulty": "easy"},
  {"name": "Chocolate Cake", "ingredients": ["flour", "sugar", "cocoa", "eggs", "butter"], "time": 90, "difficulty": "hard"}
]

print("Recipes:", len(recipes), "loaded")
print(json.dumps(recipes[0]))

verification.successMessage: Recipe data structure is ready with 5 recipes!
verification.failureMessage: Create a recipes array with at least 5 recipes, each having name, ingredients array, time, and difficulty.

steps.title: Search recipes by ingredients
steps.description: Write a `searchByIngredients` function that takes an array of ingredient names and returns recipes that contain ALL of the specified ingredients. Log the matching recipe names.
hints: Check: recipe.ingredients includes every search ingredient: searchTerms.every(ing => recipe.ingredients.includes(ing))
Log the names of matching recipes

verification.successMessage: Recipe search by ingredients returns correct matches!
verification.failureMessage: searchByIngredients(['garlic']) should return Pasta and Soup (both contain garlic).

steps.title: Filter recipes by maximum time
steps.description: Write a `filterByMaxTime` function that takes a max time in minutes and returns recipes that can be made within that time. Log the results.
hints: Log both the count and names of matching recipes

verification.successMessage: Time-based filtering returns recipes under the max time!
verification.failureMessage: filterByMaxTime(30) should return Quick Pasta (20 min) and Salad (10 min) but not Slow Roast or Stew.

steps.title: Filter recipes by difficulty
steps.description: Write a `filterByDifficulty` function that takes a difficulty level and returns recipes matching that difficulty. Log the results.
hints: Log the recipe names and their time for each match

verification.successMessage: Difficulty filtering returns the correct recipes!
verification.failureMessage: filterByDifficulty('easy') should return Scrambled Eggs and Omelette.

steps.title: Combined search sorted by ingredient match count
steps.description: Write a `findRecipes` function that takes ingredients, optional maxTime and difficulty, and returns recipes sorted by how many ingredients match (descending). Log the results.
hints: Filter by maxTime and difficulty if provided
Score each recipe by counting matching ingredients: ingredients.filter(ing => recipe.ingredients.includes(ing)).length
Sort by score descending: .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)

verification.successMessage: Combined search sorts recipes by ingredient match count!
verification.failureMessage: findRecipes(['beef', 'garlic'], 60) should return Pasta Bolognese (2 matches), then Beef Salad (2 matches), then Garlic Bread (1 match).
